_note: Our own writing. Enemy commanders as characters: every enemy force has someone in charge, and the ones who live remember the squad. NPCs have objectives of their own and care about self-preservation; surrender and retreat are valid ends to a fight, and the GM may end a fight early once the outcome isn't in question (Core p.60). Personalities decide what a commander does when the fight turns against them (when_losing) or against the squad (when_winning). Lines use no pronouns for the commander, or they/them.

honorable.name: Honorable
honorable.text: Fights fair and keeps their word.
start: {rival} here. Nothing personal, lancers. Let's keep this clean.
This is {rival}. I'll give you the same courtesy I'd want: no tricks.
{rival} to the squad: we don't have to like each other to do this right.
start_return: {rival} again. I hoped we'd meet on a better day.
We meet again. I haven't forgotten {last_time}.
{rival} here. You fought well last time. So will I.
hurt: Good hit. You've earned that one.
That's going to cost me. Well flown.
ally_down: Get them clear! Somebody pull that pilot out!
Fall back to me. Nobody else dies for this.
gloat: Your pilot's down. Get them out; I won't fire on a rescue.
Pull your friend out. I'll wait.
That's enough for one of you. Get them clear.
defeated: Reactor's gone. I yield. I yield!
refused: Then we finish it. On your head, lancers.

proud.name: Proud
proud.text: Can't stand to lose, and never forgets it.
start: You're the squad everyone talks about? I'm not impressed.
This is {rival}. Remember the name. You'll be hearing it a lot.
start_return: {rival}. Did you think I'd forget {last_time}? I've thought of nothing else.
Round two, lancers. I've been practicing.
You. Good. I've been waiting for this.
hurt: You'll pay for that paint job.
That's the last free hit you get.
ally_down: Do I have to do everything myself?
gloat: Is that all? I expected more.
Did you see that? Did everyone see that?
defeated: This isn't over! Do you hear me? This isn't over!
Not like this. Not to you!
refused: Fine. I'll take you with me.
You'll regret not letting me walk.

cunning.name: Cunning
cunning.text: Always has a way out, and something to trade.
start: {rival} here. Let's see how good you really are.
This is {rival}. Your patron didn't tell you about me, did they?
Lancers. Let's be smart about this, shall we?
start_return: {rival}. I still owe you for {last_time}. I always pay my debts.
Hello again. I've read every report on you since last time.
You again. I brought a few surprises.
ally_down: Shift left. Use the cover. Think!
We lost one. Stay on the plan.
Pull back, regroup, make them come to us.
defeated: Punching out! I'll be in touch.
refused: Your loss. I'd have made it worth your while.
Pity. We could have both walked away.

zealous.name: Zealous
zealous.text: Believes in their cause more than their own life.
start: {rival} here. You stand against something bigger than you.
This is {rival}. Turn back, or be turned back.
No retreat! Not one step back!
start_return: {rival}. I was spared last time for a reason. It was this.
We meet again. The cause hasn't changed, and neither have I.
You. I prayed you'd come back.
hurt: I've lost worse and kept fighting.
ally_down: Another one for the wall. Hold!
gloat: This is what you get for standing in our way!
defeated: I don't need a mech to fight you!
refused: Good. I wouldn't have taken it anyway.
There are no terms with you.

weary.name: Weary
weary.text: Tired of this war, and of burying friends.
start: {rival} here. I've buried too many people this year. Don't make me bury you.
This is {rival}. Let's just get this over with.
{rival} to the squad: nobody has to die out here today.
start_return: {rival}. You again. I was hoping you'd retired.
We keep doing this, don't we? {last_time}, and now this.
Back again. Neither of us learns.
hurt: That hurt. Of course it did.
I'm getting too old for this.
gloat: Get your pilot out. I'm not after anyone's life.
Stop. Get them clear. We don't need more dead.
One of yours is down. Help them.
refused: Then I guess we both lose.

ruthless.name: Ruthless
ruthless.text: Wins at any cost, and makes sure you know it.
start: {rival} here. I'm being paid either way, lancers. You're not.
This is {rival}. Nobody's coming to save you.
Lancers. Let's find out how much you're worth.
start_return: {rival}. I let you live last time. Mistake.
Back for more? This time I finish it.
hurt: That's one. You don't get two.
ally_down: Plenty more where they came from.
Step over them and keep firing!
defeated: You'll pay for this, every one of you!

yield: It's over. My people are done. What are your terms?
Enough. I'm ordering my squad to stand down. What happens now?
We yield. Nobody else needs to die for this.
withdraw: We're pulling out. Follow us and it gets expensive.
This isn't worth it. We're leaving. Don't push your luck.
All units, fall back. You win this one, lancers.
deal: Let's talk. I know things your patron doesn't tell you. Let me walk, and they're yours.
Hold fire. I've got something worth more than my mech: information. Interested?
We can both walk away richer. Hear me out.
demand_fight: You don't understand. We don't stop.
offer_retreat: You've lost, lancers. Take your wounded and go. I won't follow.
Call it. Get your people out of here and I'll hold fire.
This is your one chance. Walk away.

debrief: {rival} is in custody. What happens to them now is up to us.
{rival} surrendered. Not every fight ends with a wreck.
{rival} pulled out before the end. We'll see them again.
{rival} got away. That one won't forget you.
{rival} punched out and got away. Expect them back.
{rival}'s mech is scrap, but they made it out. They'll want payback.
{rival} didn't get out of that mech.
{rival} is dead. Whatever else they were, they were a pilot.
{rival} held the field. They'll be gloating about that.

routed.log: {rival} fled with what was left of their force.
debrief: {rival}'s force broke when the fight turned, and {rival} went with it. They'll be back.
{rival} pulled what was left of their force out. We haven't seen the last of them.

return_briefing: Intel says {rival} is leading the other side. You've met.
{rival} again. Some people don't know when to quit.
